correctness.rationale: Every context distribution with entries in {0,1/2,1} has deterministic or fair marginal; a fair–fair edge has exactly one of the two equality/inequality tables. This gives a bijection (U,b,s) and N_ND=sum_U 2^(n-|U|+e(U)). A global support assignment exists iff s is an F2 coboundary on the induced fair graph, via spanning forests. Each balanced sign class admits an explicit global distribution with independent fair root bits; unbalanced support has no global assignment, so contextual fraction is exactly 1. Counting coboundaries gives 2^(|U|-c(U)) and N_NC=sum_U 2^(n-c(U)). An explicit four-cycle denominator-three mixture of all-zero and parity-odd PR support has fraction 2/3. Independently enumerated C3 (40,36), C4 (136,128), P4 (116,116), C5 (464,448) counts and inspected separate source checker.
residual_risks: Finite checks are examples; the coboundary normal form proves all finite graphs.
